summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Banco de Chile (Bank of Chile) on April 30, 2026, as a foreign private issuer. The sole content is a press release announcing the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, with the SEC. There are no proposed transactions, corporate actions, or special-situation events disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report and does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. Accordingly, this is not a special situation.
